summary: Retest of the iteration_14 fixes. All fixes are verified, and no WhatsApp message was sent during testing. Backend pytest: 13/13 pass (5 new tests plus 8 regression tests). (1) HIGH mapping bug fixed. As navya: Find tabs -> Select all -> Clear all -> pick EU and NON-EU. campaign-mapping-2 now shows 'phone' (it was 'phone_number'), and no warning appears. Saving imported EU (13) and NON-EU (117), each with WhatsApp queued 0. Of the 130 leads, 125 have +intl phones; 5 NON-EU rows were correctly flagged as invalid or duplicate. (2) Mixed tabs as admin (Centralized + EU): the amber campaign-missing-phone-warning shows. The backend _guess_sheet_column fallback gave all 13 EU leads phones while the mapping was 'phone_number'. A unit test confirms the same fallback with a monkeypatched CSV. (3) The Save button is disabled while headers load (loadingTabs) and is re-enabled only when every tab's headers have loaded. (4) A PUT that changes the gid sets last_sync to null and deletes that connection's old leads. This was checked live via the API and in the UI edit flow (332 Centralized leads removed; the card shows 'Not synced yet'). The next sync is a first import with queued 0 and all rows marked skipped. A PUT that keeps the same gid leaves last_sync and the leads unchanged. (5) The resend endpoint returns {success:false, error:'WhatsApp rejected +4917612345678: the number is not on WhatsApp or is not a real number'}. This was tested in-process with httpx ASGITransport, a temporary DB and a monkeypatched _send_whatsapp_api. (6) Regression: multi-select connect, the 'VisaXpert Campaign Leads · 2 tabs connected' header and '2 Google Sheets connected' all work for both accounts. One minor frontend bug was found (see ui_bugs).

ui_bugs.issue: Columns that are empty are never re-guessed when new headers appear. The result depends on the order tabs are picked in. As navya: Select all -> Clear all -> pick EU (Country becomes '' because EU has no 'country' column) -> then pick NON-EU, which has 'country'. Country stays '— not mapped —', so NON-EU leads are imported without Country. Picking NON-EU first maps it correctly. The cause is the effect at line 118 (`!c.sheet_column || headers.includes(...) ? c : ...`), which keeps empty values as they are. Fix: also re-guess empty columns when headerKey changes, unless the user cleared the column by hand on purpose (track which columns were edited manually).

action_items: LOW: In CampaignSheetModal, re-guess empty (and not manually edited) mapping columns when the picked tabs' headers change, so the Country mapping does not depend on the order tabs are picked in.

Optional UX: after an edit changes the tab of a synced connection, the backend resets last_sync, but the frontend calls onSaved(..., !sheet.last_sync) and so does not auto-import. The user has to click Sync. Consider using res.data.last_sync == null to trigger the first import.
critical_code_review_comments: The frontend SYNONYMS.phone is missing 'whatsappnumber', which the backend _HEADING_SYNONYMS has. This is harmless today but the two lists should be kept in sync.
Sync fallback only re-guesses mapped columns that are missing from the sheet. A column left empty in a mixed-tab mapping is never filled in for the other tabs.
server.py is still more than 5100 lines. Credentials are still passed in query strings.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; 1 low-priority mapping edge case)

seed_data_creation: None. Connections were created temporarily for testing and then deleted in both accounts; campaign_sheets=0 and campaign_leads=0 at the end. No lead has a whatsapp status of sent, failed or queued.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tab gids: Centralized 99742259 (phone_number), EU 2139819490 (phone, no 'country' column), NON-EU 1551110032 (phone, has 'country'). Tests in test_iter15_mapping_gid_reset.py do first imports only (send_to_existing false). The gid-reset test checks that last_sync is null before it syncs again. Never run a second sync on a sheet that has already synced, and never click resend or 'Send all skipped'. Delete all sheets afterwards.
